changelog:
- YouTube Shorts Restored: Re-enabled native Shorts shelves, swipe reels, and bottom navigation pivot tab with cold-boot unprompted auto-open guard.
- YouTube Minimize/Resume Sync: Resolved playback desync where video played behind stuck buffering spinners or pause overlays when returning to the app.
- Tab Switcher Redesign: Moved Close All, + Ghost, and New Tab buttons to a pinned top header for permanent visibility with 7+ or 12+ tabs, styled in sleek AMOLED obsidian pure dark theme.
- Command Card Clean View: Removed redundant search magnifying glass icon on command card across web pages.
- Dual Screen Bug Fix: Fixed blank screen when closing dual screen mode; active tab webview now re-attaches cleanly.
- Yahoo Sports SPA Fix: Neutralized clickjacking overlay false-positives that caused a 0.5s white screen on Next.js streaming sites.
- Article Videos Unblocked: Ensured article-relevant video streams (Brightcove, Connatix, JWPlayer, Vidgyor, Yahoo Video) load seamlessly.
- Ad Blank Space Collapse: Collapsed empty ad placeholders, wrappers, and orphan 'Advertisement' labels on news sites (e.g. Hindustan Times).
